<article class="news-item">

<article class="news-item">

<p>The paper "The Cross-linguistic Role of Animacy in Grammar Structures", which I co-authored with Nina Gregorio as joint first author, won a [Senior Area Chair Award](https://2025.aclweb.org/program/awards/) at ACL in Vienna.\
